reason: I just fill my bottle at the gym fountain, so paying about $65 up front and then signing up for a filter subscription is too much for something I don't really need. And $13 shipping on the bottle alone is a dealbreaker for me.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and the bottle only gets cheap if I sign up for the filter plan. A 5% code is barely a discount.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle with one filter for around $30 with free shipping and no subscription, plus filters I can buy one at a time when I need them.
